name: Typewave design-repo
versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is MACHINE-CHECKED (extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version). pageSpecVersion is machine-checked against the schema const, and every PageSpec must carry that const. repositoryVersion is DOCUMENTATION-ONLY: hand-maintained, nothing checks it.

source.original: https://typewave.blendmodes.com/ (a real, live, commercial single-page site for a Figma plugin by Blend Modes)
source.clone: sibling project folder typewave-clone: React + Vite + Tailwind v3 + Lenis (versions below are the package.json ranges, re-checked by verify_all.py check 16)
source.snapshotNote: A snapshot, not a mirror. Another agent may edit the clone src/ (motion fixes); every conclusion this repo depends on is cited with expected text and re-verified by verify_all.py against current source.
source.vcs: The clone folder is not a git repository, so "never commit design-repo.zip next to the live folder" is trivially satisfied. If it becomes one, gitignore design-repo.zip.

constraints: REAL LIVE COMPANY: Typewave / Blend Modes marks, product videos and screenshots, OG cover and marketing copy are proprietary. Generated pages use owner-supplied marks and newly generated media stand-ins only (assets/asset-roles.json pinnedPolicies; ASSET_REF_POLICY, ASSET_ROLE_PINNED).
PLACEHOLDER COPY: the clone and this repo's example use ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER copy from src/content.js; the live copy is never transcribed (verify_all check 15 guards both directions).
THIRD-PARTY MARKS: Figma, Cursor, VS Code, Claude, OpenAI and Lovable logos are must-not-fabricate.
LOTTIE BANNED: recon-assets/breakpoint-lottie.json embeds the original copy; the mockup is an HTML/CSS rebuild (role media.device-mockup, html-rebuild-only).
COMMERCIAL FONTS: Roobert (400/500 rendered) and Vesterbro (declared, unused) need a licence; no font files ship here.

LIVE ENDPOINTS: Lemon Squeezy checkouts / newsletter POST / legal pages, the Figma Community plugin URL, the company mailbox and affiliate.js are must-not-reuse-live-endpoint (LIVE_ENDPOINT_NOT_REUSED).
SINGLE ROUTE: one route (/), one template (template.home, homeRouteOnly).
